name: Victory In a Blink

passive.name: Final Hit
passive.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {p1}%. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability on an ally target, increases the DMG dealt by all ally targets by {p2}%, lasting for {p3} turn(s).

lore: The Titankins' all-consuming roars sweep across the battlefield. Two lightning-quick figures slaughter their way out of combat. "I alone will be enough to handle them." Every punch unleashed by the warrior sends spears of blood through the bodies of the enemy. "Brute force and nothing more. Watch my blade!" As a blade of pale silver slices in a curve, monsters drop like falling leaves. "A contest of speed?" The two charge at the other side simultaneously. Howls of anguish sound as the stealthy beasts behind them are struck down at once. Two voices can be heard at the same time. "That was my kill!"
